name: TRUMP COIN
description:
THE BITCOIN KING 👑₿ *MAKE BITCOIN GREAT AGAIN*

A larger-than-life depiction of Donald Trump entering the crypto world as the ultimate Bitcoin king. Wearing a golden crown, Bitcoin sunglasses, and a luxurious gold chain, Trump confidently holds a massive glowing Bitcoin coin toward the viewer. Behind him, a raging golden bull symbolizes unstoppable market momentum, while a Bitcoin rocket launches toward the moon alongside a massive green rising chart. The American flag waves dramatically in the background, bringing together patriotism, wealth, and crypto culture.

The artwork combines professional cinematic realism with exaggerated viral meme energy, using explosive golden lighting, fiery effects, and bold visuals to capture the excitement of a crypto bull run.

The overall message: Bitcoin is taking over, the bulls are charging, and the crypto revolution is just getting started. 🚀

name: Robot Context Protocol
description: This project focuses on designing, specifying, and prototyping a robust Interactive Integrity Protocol layered on or integrated with the Robot Context Protocol (RCP). RCP is a lightweight, middleware-agnostic, runtime-agnostic communication framework that provides a unified, schema-driven interface (via HTTP/WebSocket) for robots, human operators, and autonomous agents (including LLM-based agents). It supports operations such as read, write, execute, and subscribe, with features like runtime introspection, asynchronous feedback, multi-tenant isolation, and type validation
